english.note: Use this casual construction when putting off doing an action until later rather than rescheduling a fixed event.
Use this very natural spoken construction when putting off doing an action until later.

examples.english: I’ll postpone doing the homework; I have to leave now.
examples.traditional: 份功課遲啲先做啦，我而家要出門口。
examples.jyutping: fan2 gung1 fo3 ci4 di1 sin1 zou6 laa1 ngo5 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 ceot1 mun4 hau2

examples.english: I’ll delay replying to you until later.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ci4 di1 sin1 fuk1 nei5
